title: Kitchen
story: Something tasty is about to happen in the kitchen.

cards.name: Whisk
cards.subject: A balloon whisk: a round teardrop bundle of silver wire loops joined at the bottom into a red handle.
cards.hero_colors: silver wires, red handle

cards.name: Toaster
cards.subject: A chrome two-slot toaster with rounded corners, two golden-brown toast slices popping up from the slots, and a red lever on the side.
cards.hero_colors: chrome silver, golden-brown toast, red lever

cards.name: Frying Pan
cards.subject: A round black frying pan seen at a slight angle with a long wooden handle fixed to its rim, holding two fried eggs with white edges and yellow yolks.
cards.hero_colors: black pan, wood brown handle, white and yellow eggs

cards.name: Kettle
cards.subject: A round-bellied stovetop kettle with a curved spout, a arched handle over the top and a knob on the lid, standing on a burner of a stove with white steam rising from the spout.
cards.hero_colors: teal enamel kettle, yellow lid knob
cards.surface_or_setting: black stovetop burner in front of a tiled kitchen wall

cards.name: Oven Mitts
cards.subject: A pair of thick quilted oven mitts, each with a thumb and a cuff, one with a small house pictogram patch stitched on the back in one color.
cards.hero_colors: orange quilted mitts, cream house patch

cards.name: Cooking Pot
cards.subject: A tall round stainless steel stockpot with two side handles riveted to the body and a domed lid with a black knob.
cards.hero_colors: stainless silver, black knob and handle grips

cards.name: Rolling Pin
cards.subject: A wooden rolling pin lying flat: a smooth straight cylinder with a round handle at each end, resting on a flat round of dough.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown pin, cream dough

cards.name: Spice Rack
cards.subject: A wooden wall shelf screwed to the wall holding a row of three identical round glass spice jars with metal lids, filled with red paprika, green herbs and yellow turmeric.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown shelf, glass jars, red, green and yellow spices
cards.surface_or_setting: plain kitchen wall above the counter

cards.name: Faucet
cards.subject: A chrome kitchen faucet with a tall curved neck mounted on the back edge of a white sink, with a blue handle on its side and a clear stream of water falling into the basin.
cards.hero_colors: chrome silver, white sink, blue handle
cards.surface_or_setting: white sink basin with tiled wall behind

cards.name: Cookie Jar
cards.subject: A round ceramic cookie jar with a domed lid and a round knob, a small flat cow-face pictogram printed in black on its front, and a few round chocolate cookies beside it.
cards.hero_colors: cream ceramic, black cow-face, brown cookies

cards.name: Whisk
cards.subject: A balloon whisk: a round teardrop bundle of silver wire loops joined at the bottom into a yellow silicone handle.

cards.name: Rolling Pin
cards.subject: A wooden rolling pin lying flat: a smooth straight cylinder with a round handle at each end, on a round of dough dusted with flour.

cards.name: Kettle
cards.subject: A round-bellied kettle with a curved spout, a arched handle over the top and a lid knob, with white steam curling from the spout.
